name: One match with its replay
description: Two rows out of Postgres: replay_key for the presign task, and one `body` column holding the whole response. The seats come from match_seats -- under v2 a match's players are rows, not three positionally-aligned arrays -- so this is an ordinary join and `seat` is the column rather than an ordinality. `rating_change` is a second join onto rating_events, which is null until count has folded the match: that is the point of showing status alongside it, because a competitor sees the result before they see what it did to their rating. A cancelled match carries withdrawn_reason and, where a promotion caused it, the successor that replaced the seat; a failed one carries the fault and which seat it was attributed to. replay_url is null for any row that never produced a replay. SOMA-GAPS 2.4: three things the Match screen prints that this route did not return. `ladders` is the *Counted on* row -- a populated column no route read, and the reason a mixed game says Open alone. Each seat now carries its `class`, because the coloured square is on every model everywhere, and `baseline`, because a baseline is a user and would otherwise render as `by @tb.ants.greedy` where the page says `a platform baseline`. `outcome` is the mark beside the name, and it is computed here rather than by the caller for one reason: a forfeited seat is `dq` and a beaten one is `loss`, and telling them apart needs forfeit_strikes -- which the response also returns as `strike_limit`, so the page can draw 2 of 5 without a second source of the same number. `successor` resolves the bare uuid into the owner and version the cancelled sentence names.

input.query: SELECT mt.replay_key, json_build_object( 'id', mt.id, 'game', g.slug, 'season', (SELECT se.number FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = mt.season_id), 'status', mt.status, 'seed', mt.seed, 'preset', mt.preset, 'reason', mt.reason, 'turns', mt.turns, 'played_ms', mt.played_ms, 'played_at', mt.played_at, 'created_at', mt.created_at, 'withdrawn_reason', mt.withdrawn_reason, 'successor_id', mt.successor_id, 'fault_reason', mt.fault_reason, 'fault_seat', mt.fault_seat, 'engine_digest', mt.engine_digest_played, 'evaluator_digest', mt.evaluator_digest, 'is_trial', mt.trial_model_id IS NOT NULL, 'ladders', array_to_json(mt.ladders), 'strike_limit', ($2)::int, 'successor', (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', sm.id, 'owner', su.handle, 'version', sm.version) FROM models sm JOIN users su ON su.id = sm.owner_id WHERE sm.id = mt.successor_id), 'players', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'seat', s.seat, 'model_id', s.model_id, 'owner', u.handle, 'baseline', u.role = 'baseline', 'class', md.weight_class, 'model_version', md.version, 'outcome', CASE WHEN s.rank IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.strikes >= ($2)::int THEN 'dq' WHEN s.rank > 1 THEN 'loss' WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM match_seats w WHERE w.match_id = s.match_id AND w.rank = 1) > 1 THEN 'draw' ELSE 'win' END, 'rank', s.rank, 'score', s.score, 'strikes', s.strikes, 'rating_change', (SELECT json_object_agg(e.ladder, json_build_object( 'mu_before', e.mu_before, 'sigma_before', e.sigma_before, 'mu_after', e.mu_after, 'sigma_after', e.sigma_after)) FROM rating_events e WHERE e.match_id = mt.id AND e.seat = s.seat)) ORDER BY s.seat), '[]'::json) FROM match_seats s LEFT JOIN models md ON md.id = s.model_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = md.owner_id WHERE s.match_id = mt.id)) AS body FROM matches mt JOIN games g ON g.id = mt.game_id WHERE mt.id = ($1)::uuid
